verdict.rationale: The RX 9070 XT is a discrete GPU, a local hardware product with no hosted account or vendor-held user data. 'Export all of my data and leave' is a data-portability question for services that hold user data, so it is a category error for a graphics card. The evidence on the open-source ROCm stack and HIP CUDA-porting wrappers concerns code and software portability, which is a different story and does not transfer here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
